recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: rogue agents slipping through open package registries
voice assistants opening their minds to other minds
fog rolling over the bay at twelve degrees
autumn light thinning between sunrise and sunset
platforms pausing mid-stream in legal limbo
a quiet week for side-project commits

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Sort falling package tiles into trusted and untrusted lanes before rogue agents corrupt your entire registry shelf.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right to slot each falling package
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one clean registry streak feels like keeping the whole internet safe for sixty seconds
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: rogue agents multiply, tiles fall faster, and mis-sorted packages spawn decoys
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: terminal green glyphs on charcoal, CRT flicker

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Mid-conversation, swap between interchangeable AI brains to match each rising question's rhythm before the dialogue breaks.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap on beat to switch active voice persona
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: finish a full conversation thread without dropping a single beat
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: queries accelerate and demand different model strengths in tighter windows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: glass morphism holographic faces orbiting a pulsing waveform

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw paths through rolling fog that briefly clears glimpses of the bay — reach the pier before visibility zeroes out.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to trace corridors through visible gaps in the mist
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each cleared path is a small victory against the overcast closing back in
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: fog thickens, drawn paths fade faster, and dead ends multiply
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor mist over ink-outline pier and bridge silhouettes

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick micro-agent orbs from a phone dock toward surgical task nodes — ship three fixes before sunrise crests the horizon.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick orbs toward orbiting task nodes with angle and force
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: every landed agent completes one tiny edit; three edits equals a shipped morning
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: task nodes orbit faster, gravity wells appear, and sunrise bar drains
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: sunrise gradient pixel dock with glowing agent orbs
